title: AWS KMS Data-Key Adapter

transitions.note: Created from current main after KMS dependencies were merged.
Implement GenerateDataKey/Decrypt adapter using Vercel OIDC credentials only; no static AWS credentials, no live KMS call.

After one TypeScript weak-type fix, CI passed audit, typecheck, lint, full tests, env/model verifier tests, build, state/docs checks and smoke. Unit tests verify KMS commands and OIDC-only configuration guards.
AWS KMS adapter code completed without live AWS calls, infrastructure mutation, environment changes, credential persistence or route activation.
PR review identified the documented KMS env-name mismatch and duplicate plaintext DEK buffer. Both were corrected; review threads were replied to and resolved.
Post-review CI passed fully. Adapter now uses AI_CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID and immediately wipes the original AWS SDK plaintext DEK buffer after copying.

notes: Completed unit-tested KMS GenerateDataKey(AES_256)/Decrypt adapter using @vercel/oidc-aws-credentials-provider. Static AWS access-key envs are explicitly rejected. Review fixes aligned AI_CREDENTIAL_KMS_KEY_ID with project docs and zero the SDK-owned plaintext DEK. Live AWS KMS/IAM/OIDC infrastructure remains external.
